THERMALVORTEX-ARCHAIC_TOOTH.description: Upon pickup, remove 1 [gold]Alpha E-Coil[/gold] and 1 [gold]Alpha M-Coil[/gold] to create 1 [gold]Electromagnetic Coil[/gold]. Each upgraded material upgrades it once.
THERMALVORTEX-ARCHAIC_TOOTH.eventDescrip: Remove 1 [gold]Alpha E-Coil[/gold] and 1 [gold]Alpha M-Coil[/gold] to create 1 [gold]Electromagnetic Coil[/gold]. Each upgraded material upgrades it once.
THERMALVORTEX-THERMAL_VORTEX_CORE.title: Unfinished Millennium Puzzle
THERMALVORTEX-THERMAL_VORTEX_CORE.descri: The Puzzle's missing pieces open onto myriad paths. You have an [gold]Extra Deck[/gold] and can wield the signature mechanics of selected cards from other characters, such as Stars, Orbs, and summoning a companion.
THERMALVORTEX-THERMAL_VORTEX_CORE.flavor: The last pieces have not settled, but old memories already stir in the gaps.
THERMALVORTEX-ANCIENT_THERMAL_VORTEX_COR: With the Puzzle complete, myriad paths converge. You have an [gold]Extra Deck[/gold] and can wield the signature mechanics of selected cards from other characters, such as Stars, Orbs, and summoning a companion. At the opening of each turn, before you draw, return your starting [gold]Fusion[/gold] from your Discard Pile to the top of your Draw Pile, making it the next card you draw.
When every piece locks into place, another soul wakes in golden light.
THERMALVORTEX-LAYERED_COIL.title: Layered Coil
THERMALVORTEX-LAYERED_COIL.description: The first time a Monster is summoned by a card effect each turn, draw 1 card.
THERMALVORTEX-LAYERED_COIL.flavor: Every layer holds one more charge than it should.
